0022600203.text: The Lakers (8-2, 3-1 on the road, first in the Pacific and third in the West) arrive on a four-game winning streak and have won eight of their last ten, but Luka Doncic is out with back soreness. The Hawks (7-4, 3-2 at home, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East) also enter on a four-game winning streak after a 6-4 stretch over their last ten, and they will be without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet this season, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Lakers winning the most recent meeting 141-116 in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026.
